column_desc: Order identifier. One order spans multiple rows (one row per product in the order)
Date the order was placed, local date of the city (format: YYYY-MM-DD)
Hour the order was placed, local time of the city (0-23)
New = the customer's first order ever, Returning = any later order
Delivery city (London, New York, Berlin, Paris, Tokyo, Seoul, Singapore, Sydney)
Product name (e.g., Spaghetti, Oat Milk, Sourdough Bread)
Product category (e.g., Produce, Dairy & Eggs, Bakery, Ready Meals, Plant-based)
Price per unit before discount (reporting currency: USD)
Number of units of the product in the order
Amount paid for this row: unit_price * quantity - discount (USD)

Promotion applied to this row; empty if none. At most one code per order, so codes never stack. SAVE10 = coupon for Returning customers only, 10% off every row of the order. WELCOME10 = applied automatically to every order of a New customer whose gross value (sum of unit_price * quantity) is $50 or more; $10 off the order, split across its rows. PASTA30 = 30% off Spaghetti rows on 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-11, applied automatically only when the order has no SAVE10 or WELCOME10 code
